summary.en: Leading Chinese AI company with GLM series models and strong academic background.
summary.zh: 领先的中国 AI 公司，提供 GLM 系列模型，具备强大的学术背景。

title.en: Zhipu AI API Key - GLM Series Chinese Models | Get Model Key
title.zh: 智谱AI API Key - GLM 系列中国模型 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get Zhipu AI API key for GLM series models. Access GLM-4, GLM-4V and CodeGeeX with strong Chinese capabilities.
description.zh: 获取智谱AI API Key，访问 GLM 系列模型。使用 GLM-4、GLM-4V 和 CodeGeeX，具备强大的中文能力。

benefit.en: New users may receive around 20M tokens, typically valid for about 3 months (subject to official policy).
benefit.zh: 新用户可获约 2000 万 Token（约 3 个月有效，具体以官方规则为准）。

notes.en: Backed by a strong academic background and generous onboarding incentives; GLM-4 models fit coding and bug-fixing workflows well.
notes.zh: 团队学术背景扎实，活动力度较大；GLM-4 系列在代码编写和缺陷排查场景表现突出。

en: Zhipu AI (智谱) offers the GLM model family via bigmodel.cn / open.bigmodel.cn, with strong Chinese language and multimodal capabilities.
Developers use Zhipu’s Open Platform for chat, vision, and coding-oriented models such as GLM and CodeGeeX-related offerings.
getModelKey only links open.bigmodel.cn’s official API keys center. We do not sell Zhipu keys.
zh: 智谱 AI 通过 bigmodel.cn / open.bigmodel.cn 提供 GLM 系列模型，中文与多模态能力突出。
开发者可在智谱开放平台调用对话、视觉及代码相关模型（如 GLM、CodeGeeX 相关能力）。
getModelKey 仅链接 open.bigmodel.cn 官方 API Key 中心，不出售智谱密钥。

en: Visit open.bigmodel.cn/usercenter/apikeys and sign in to your Zhipu Open Platform account.
Create a new API key in the user center, then copy and store it securely.
Call the APIs using the endpoints and auth headers described in open.bigmodel.cn developer docs.
Prefer server-side usage, set spending limits if available, and rotate keys after any leak.
zh: 访问 open.bigmodel.cn/usercenter/apikeys，登录智谱开放平台账号。
在用户中心创建新的 API Key，复制后妥善保存。
按 open.bigmodel.cn 开发者文档中的端点与鉴权方式调用 API。
优先在服务端使用；如有额度/消费限制请开启，泄露后立即轮换。

question.en: Is bigmodel.cn the official Zhipu API platform?
question.zh: bigmodel.cn 是智谱官方 API 平台吗？

answer.en: Yes. open.bigmodel.cn is Zhipu’s open platform for API keys and developer docs for GLM and related services.
answer.zh: 是。open.bigmodel.cn 是智谱开放平台，用于管理 API Key 与查阅 GLM 等相关开发文档。

question.en: Does getModelKey sell Zhipu / GLM API keys?
question.zh: getModelKey 出售智谱 / GLM API Key 吗？

answer.en: No. We only link the official API keys page. Keys are created and billed on Zhipu’s platform.
answer.zh: 不出售。我们只链接官方密钥页；密钥在智谱平台创建并计费。

question.en: Where should I check GLM pricing and free trials?
question.zh: GLM 价格与免费试用以哪里为准？

answer.en: Always check Zhipu’s official open platform and announcements. Trial amounts and rates change; we do not invent prices.
answer.zh: 请以智谱开放平台与官方公告为准。试用额度与费率会变化，本站不编造价格。
